title: The Coolest Mod That Has Ever Exsisted
description: my poorly done attempt at making a minecraft mod adds a new tier of ore above netherite called magmasteel and nothing else
body: My attempt to make a mod that adds a new tier of recoruces past netherite called magmasteel, to make it you have to find the magmasteel ore in the nether and mine it and smelt the raw magmasteeel in a blast furnace for 20 seconds then craft netherite tools or armor with a magmasteel ingot and smithing template in a smithing table to make magmasteel tools or amror.
